Implementation plan:
- Files:
  - core/health.py (new): Provide a pure function health() returning {"status": "ok"} and a minimal WSGI app callable app that serves GET/HEAD /health with JSON.
  - tests/test_health.py (new): Unit tests for health() and the WSGI endpoint behavior (status code, headers, body).
- Primary design decisions:
  - Framework-agnostic: expose a simple health() for reuse and a minimal WSGI app to satisfy “endpoint” without external deps.
  - Support GET and HEAD; return application/json; UTF-8 encoding; no cache headers.
- Risks:
  - If the project expects a specific web framework (Flask/FastAPI/Django), integration may require adapter code.
  - Test relies on WSGI contract; if project test utilities differ, minor adjustments may be needed.

{
  "operations": [
    {
      "action": "create",
      "path": "core/health.py",
      "content": "import json
from typing import Callable, Iterable, List, Tuple


__all__ = ["health", "app"]


def health() -> dict:
    """Return basic service health status."""
    return {"status": "ok"}


def _json_response(payload: dict, status: str = "200 OK") -> Tuple[str, List[Tuple[str, str]], bytes]:
    body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    headers = [
        ("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8"),
        ("Content-Length", str(len(body))),
        ("Cache-Control", "no-store"),
    ]
    return status, headers, body


def app(environ: dict, start_response: Callable) -> Iterable[bytes]:
    """Minimal WSGI app exposing /health.

    - GET /health -> 200 {"status": "ok"}
    - HEAD /health -> 200 with headers only
    """
    path = environ.get("PATH_INFO", "") or "/"
    method = environ.get("REQUEST_METHOD", "GET").upper()

    if path == "/health" and method in {"GET", "HEAD"}:
        status, headers, body = _json_response(health())
        start_response(status, headers)
        return [] if method == "HEAD" else [body]

    # Not found
    not_found_body = b""
    start_response(
        "404 Not Found",
        [("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8"), ("Content-Length", str(len(not_found_body)))],
    )
    return [not_found_body]
",
      "reason": "Add health check endpoint and reusable function."
    },
    {
      "action": "create",
      "path": "tests/test_health.py",
      "content": "import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

import core.health as health_mod


def test_health_function_returns_ok():
    assert health_mod.health() == {"status": "ok"}


def _call_wsgi(app, method="GET", path="/health"):
    captured = SimpleNamespace(status=None, headers=None)

    def start_response(status, headers):
        captured.status = status
        captured.headers = dict(headers)

    environ = {
        "REQUEST_METHOD": method,
        "PATH_INFO": path,
        "QUERY_STRING": "",
        "SERVER_NAME": "testserver",
        "SERVER_PORT": "80",
        "wsgi.version": (1, 0),
        "wsgi.url_scheme": "http",
        "wsgi.input": None,
        "wsgi.errors": None,
        "wsgi.multithread": False,
        "wsgi.multiprocess": False,
        "wsgi.run_once": False,
    }

    body_chunks = list(app(environ, start_response))
    body = b"".join(body_chunks)
    return captured, body


def test_wsgi_health_get_ok_json():
    captured, body = _call_wsgi(health_mod.app, method="GET", path="/health")
    assert captured.status.startswith("200")
    assert captured.headers.get("Content-Type", "").startswith("application/json")
    assert json.loads(body.decode("utf-8")) == {"status": "ok"}


def test_wsgi_health_head_ok_no_body():
    captured, body = _call_wsgi(health_mod.app, method="HEAD", path="/health")
    assert captured.status.startswith("200")
    assert captured.headers.get("Content-Length") == str(len(json.dumps({"status": "ok"}).encode("utf-8")))
    assert body == b""


def test_wsgi_not_found():
    captured, body = _call_wsgi(health_mod.app, method="GET", path="/unknown")
    assert captured.status.startswith("404")
    assert captured.headers.get("Content-Type", "").startswith("text/plain")
    assert body == b""
",
      "reason": "Add unit tests for health function and WSGI endpoint behavior."
    }
  ]
}
